about.en: Tractor Supply Company is the largest US rural lifestyle retailer, operating more than 2,200 stores that sell livestock and pet feed, animal health products, fencing, agricultural equipment, hardware, workwear and outdoor power equipment to farmers, ranchers and home-and-land owners. TSCO represents its common stock listed on Nasdaq; it is a different company from the UK grocer Tesco, which also uses a TSCO ticker on the London Stock Exchange.
